title: Reward Gallery
summary: Three choices, many item slots and named NBT rewards.
description: A short manual research requiring four paper.
Choose one of three reward groups: bulk supplies, named tools, or gemstones.
The supply group contains twelve item kinds and wraps over several rows. The tool group preserves item NBT.
After claiming, reopen the screen to check the claimed state. The other groups must not become claimable.

pe_showcase:gallery_gems.title: Gemstone Collection
pe_showcase:gallery_gems.description: Two diamonds, four emeralds and sixteen quartz.

pe_showcase:gallery_supplies.title: Field Supplies
pe_showcase:gallery_supplies.description: Twelve different item kinds fill several rows. Inspect every slot before choosing this group.

pe_showcase:gallery_tools.title: Named Field Tools
pe_showcase:gallery_tools.description: A named pickaxe and bow retain their display NBT when the real reward is delivered.
